labels.hypothesis: A child is born in a miraculous or magical way.
A character leaves home and sets out into the world.
A character must complete a difficult task or pass a test.
A helper, such as an animal, an old woman or a spirit, helps the hero.
A monster, giant, dragon or ogre is defeated or killed.
A magical object with special powers is used.
Someone is transformed into an animal, an object or another person.
Someone breaks a prohibition and does what was forbidden.
Someone receives a gift.
Two characters get married.
A character becomes a king or a ruler.
A character gains treasure or great wealth.
A character takes revenge on someone.
Two characters make a bargain or a pact.
A character dies or is killed.
A dead character comes back to life.
Characters fight each other.
A character runs away or escapes from danger.
A character returns home.
A wrongdoer is punished.
A character tricks or deceives another character.
